name: Between Ifs And Maybes
source:
You enter a prestigious company with a singular goal: securing a job, building a family, and adhering to societal expectations of a conventional happily ever after.  Your journey unfolds through encounters with diverse characters and moral dilemmas.

You delve into the delicate balance between personal aspirations and exploring themes of self-discovery and resilience in pursuing a fulfilling life. Will you reach a happy ending or will you remain lost finding happiness?

[From [url=https://chanchangames.itch.io/between-ifs-and-maybes]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你带着一个单一的目标进入一家享有盛誉的公司：找到一份工作，建立一个家庭，并遵守社会对从此过上幸福生活的传统期望。你的旅程通过遇到不同的人物和道德困境而展开。

你深入研究个人愿望与探索自我发现和追求充实生活的韧性主题之间的微妙平衡。你会得到幸福的结局还是会迷失幸福？

[来自[url=https://chanchangames.itch.io/between-ifs-and-maybes]itch.io[/url]]
